verified_contracts.finding: Isaac Sim 6 returns separate lower and upper arrays; the adapter decodes and validates that representation.
The collision prim is /World/GroundPlane/collisionPlane rather than the parent Xform.
The first observation is deferred until the C++ executor acknowledges the lifecycle start, then a bootstrap request is observed before the main observation is released.
A terminal observation stops execution immediately while permitting one matching TERMINATE request to record the actual success value; duplicates remain rejected.
Runtime-close and summary-write failures cannot mask the primary episode error; all owned cleanup stages are attempted and cleanup metadata is retained.
Exact raw reset hashes remain integrity evidence, while direct preregistered numeric tolerances are authoritative across separately started Kit batches; quaternion comparison is sign invariant.

ROS does not order separate topics, so the C++ state machine retains one bounded pre-registration response per request ID and validates it immediately after matching request provenance registers. Matching cleanup includes episode and full source provenance, preventing persistent-run request-ID collisions.

first_native_run_checks: Inspect command_motion_audit requested_target_delta_m, applied_target_delta_m, and measured_end_effector_delta_m on the first delayed development episode.
Confirm initial safe-hold requested and physically applied targets remain within the preregistered reset tolerance.
Treat a dropped Profile-2 sync response as an intentionally in-flight request until terminal drain and report any episode-long hold honestly.

current_source_native_preflight.interpretation: The official Isaac Pixi environment validated every baseline manifest against current source before the fixed GPU gate. The occupied GPU caused a fail-closed refusal; this is unavailable native execution, not a failed task episode or a zero result.

interpretation: These checks validate installed API assumptions, failure semantics, and exact current-source preflight binding. Raw per-run process and path inventories were hash-recorded but omitted for privacy and repository hygiene. These checks are not physical-task success evidence and do not substitute for a completed native Isaac episode.
